div.div: Each widget owns its own query, its own skeleton, and its own error boundary. A failing widget shows a retry in its own card; the other five are unaffected.

div.div: Independent widgets is the easy half. The half people miss is that six things arriving at six different times is six chances to reflow the page — so every widget gets a fixed-height skeleton before it gets a query.
